paite: Huan kei hon houpih angel ahong pai nawn a, mi ihmu lai phawn bang in ahong phawng hi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna Muhna

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ngai in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna, adawn a noubem leh apeng a khawnvak sagih omte, huai a khawnvak sagihte toh ka mu, chi in ka dawng hi.
Huan Olive sing nih akiang a om, khat noubem taklam pang ah khat veilam pang ah," ka chi hi.
Huan ka dawng a, kei hon houpih angel kiang ah thu ka gen a, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
Kei hon houpih angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua na thei kei maw?" achi a. Ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
Huaitak in ama'n hon dawng a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Zerubbabel kiang a TOUPA thu ahi: Thahatna in hilou, thilhihtheihna in leng hi sam lou, ka Kha in ahi zaw, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
heading: Zerubbabel Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam

paite: Kua na hia, Aw tang thupi? Zerubbabel ma ah mun zang na hong hi ding; ama'n atung ah, 'Hehpihna, hehpihna!' chi a kikou in suang poimohpen ahon lakhe ding hi," achi hi.
Huai lou in TOUPA thu ka kiang ahong tung lai a, hichi in achi:
"Zerubbabel khut in hiai inn suangphum akoih khinta; akhutte mah in azou ding, huan Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawlta chih na thei ding," chi in.
Thil neu kipat ni kua'n asimmoh thei a? Zerubbabel khut ah ulum amu ding ua, akipak ding uh. Hiai TOUPA mit sagihte ahi; leitung pumpi kantan a vialtaite.
Huan ke'n ka dawng a akiang ah, "Khawnvak koihna taklam pang tung a hiai olive sing nihte leh huai aveilam pang a bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
Anihveina ding in ka dong nawn a, akiang ah, "Dangka-eng kahiang nihte sik a om, dangka-eng sathau amau a kipan suah zel olive hiang nihte bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
Ama'n hon dawng a, hiaite bang hi ding ahi ua chih thei lou maw? achi a. Huan ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
Huaitak in ama'n, "Hiaite leitung pumpi TOUPA kiang a dingh, thaunilh nihte ahi uh," achi hi.
